test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive/active voice.**

Let the experts emphasise the importance of renewable energy.

options.text: Let the importance of renewable energy be emphasised by the experts.
The importance of renewable energy let be emphasised by the experts.
Let the importance of renewable energy is emphasised by the experts.
The importance of renewable energy will be emphasised by the experts.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Let the importance of renewable energy be emphasised by the experts.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

 
• The given sentence is in active voice.
 
• To convert it into passive voice, we need to make the object of the sentence (importance of renewable energy) the subject and use the passive form of the verb (be emphasised).
 
• The doer of the action (**experts**) becomes the agent
